answer: The sparrow holds work receipts rather than names, so the orchard of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. What survives to the garden is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
